g.text: J306 NTC + R303 form an ADC divider; C301 filters noise. Confirm thermistor curve and ESP32 ADC range/calibration.

g.desc: J306 NTC + R303 form an ADC divider; C301 filters noise. Confirm thermistor curve and ESP32 ADC range/calibration.

g.text: IMUs: ICM-20948 breakouts, polled I2C. J303/J304 pins 1/2/3/4 -> VIN/GND/SDA/SCL. Software fusion required.

g.desc: IMUs: ICM-20948 breakouts, polled I2C. J303/J304 pins 1/2/3/4 -> VIN/GND/SDA/SCL. Software fusion required.

g.text: The mux is OFF-BOARD. Its channel ports are J305; it is not replaced by shorting the SDA/SCL lines together.

g.desc: The mux is OFF-BOARD. Its channel ports are J305; it is not replaced by shorting the SDA/SCL lines together.

g.text: Mux A0/A1/A2 -> 3.3V: 0x77 avoids PCA9685 ALLCALL 0x70. Select ONE channel at a time. Not Qwiic pin numbering.

g.desc: Mux A0/A1/A2 -> 3.3V: 0x77 avoids PCA9685 ALLCALL 0x70. Select ONE channel at a time. Not Qwiic pin numbering.

g.text: ESP32 IS USB-POWERED FROM THE PI. ALL SIGNAL LEVELS HERE ARE 3.3V.

g.desc: ESP32 IS USB-POWERED FROM THE PI. ALL SIGNAL LEVELS HERE ARE 3.3V.

g.text: Set PCA9685 A0 jumper CLOSED: 0x41. A mux channel alone does NOT avoid upstream INA228 address 0x40.

g.desc: Set PCA9685 A0 jumper CLOSED: 0x41. A mux channel alone does NOT avoid upstream INA228 address 0x40.
